entries.title: Zechariah 2:1
segments:
CHAP. II. 
 
  A vision signifying the prosperous state of Jerusalem, ver. 1-5.   An exhortation to the Jews, to hasten into their own land,   ver. 6-9.   Encouragement to them that were returned, and advice to wait   patiently for God, ver. 10-13. 
 
  V. 1. With a line-Ready and prepared to lay out the platform of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:2
segments: V. 2. To measure-To take the exact dimensions of it, that it may answer God's promise, and be capable to receive its inhabitants. Jerusalem-The city which was to be built hereafter.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:3
segments: V. 3. The angel-Christ, who had so long talked with Zechariah. Went forth-From the midst of the myrtle-trees.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:4
segments: V. 4. And he said-Christ to that angel who came to meet him. Run-Hasten and tell Zechariah.  As towns-The suburbs of it shall be as towns unwalled, for extent and for safety.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:5
segments: V. 5. The glory-My presence and favour shall make her glorious.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:6
segments: V. 6. Ho, ho-Ye sleepy Jews.  Come forth-Come out from your prisons.  Flee-Make all the haste you can. From the land-Babylon, which lay north of Canaan. For I have spread you abroad-As I executed my threats in scattering you, so I will perform my promise, and gather you.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:7
segments: V. 7. Deliver thyself-Accept of thy deliverance.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:8
segments: V. 8. After the glory-After that he is become your glory, I am to avenge you of your enemies.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:9
segments: V. 9. Upon them-Against the nation that doth violence to my people. Unto their servants-Unto the Jews, who were first spoiled by, and then made servants to them.  Hath sent me-To inform them of my father's will.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:10
segments: V. 10. I come-To execute judgments on thine adversaries, and to compleat thy deliverance and salvation.  I will dwell-This was fulfilled in part to the Jews, but more fully to the gospel church.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:11
segments: V. 11. Shall be joined-Shall worship the God of Israel. In that day-When Christ shall come in the flesh, and take down the partition wall.  Sent me-The Messiah.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:12
segments: V. 12. Shall inherit-Claim, recover, possess, and delight in, as a man doth in his paternal inheritance.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:13
segments: V. 13. Be silent-Reverence and adore God, and expect the accomplishment of his word.  All flesh-Both Jew and Gentile. He is raised up-God is on this work already, and he will not sit down again, 'till he has accomplished his whole work.
